scoring_guidance: Draft scale for prototype testing only. These labels are not an approved qualification scoring standard.

tasks.task_name: Interpret job instructions and plan work
criteria: Identifies relevant job instructions and drawings
Identifies required materials and consumables
Identifies visible defects or missing components
Reports unclear instructions or shortages
safety_controls: Use a simulated work order or de-energized training setup
Do not proceed when instructions are unclear

criteria: Performs a visual inspection
Identifies visible damage or loose connections
Reports defective or inadequate components
Follows the provided inspection instructions
safety_controls: Do not handle damaged energized equipment

tasks.task_name: Demonstrate an installation or assembly sequence
criteria: Follows the supplied job instructions
Selects the specified components and consumables
Follows the approved assembly sequence
Identifies and reports a simulated assembly error
safety_controls: Use a training board or approved de-energized setup
Qualified assessor must approve the task setup

criteria: Identifies the required tests from the task instructions
Selects appropriate test equipment
Explains the applicable safe testing sequence
Records or reports the observed test results
safety_controls: Use a simulator or approved de-energized training rig
Any physical testing must follow qualified supervision and approved procedures

criteria: Gathers the information needed to investigate the fault
Identifies a plausible cause from the supplied evidence
Explains the appropriate corrective action
Documents or reports the findings
safety_controls: Use a fault simulator or de-energized training equipment
Do not introduce real electrical hazards to create a fault

tasks.task_name: Identify workplace hazards and safety controls
criteria: Identifies hazards in the supplied work scenario
Selects relevant safety precautions
Identifies appropriate PPE and safety equipment
Explains when work must stop and the hazard must be reported
safety_controls: No real hazardous exposure is required

tasks.task_name: Respond to a simulated workplace emergency
criteria: Identifies the appropriate emergency procedure
Explains how to raise the alarm and obtain help
Identifies the need to avoid unsafe contact with electrical hazards
Explains the limits of their first-aid training
safety_controls: Use role-play or a simulated scenario
Do not use a real electrical incident or unsafe live demonstration

criteria: Communicates task information clearly
Reports a simulated defect or shortage
Responds appropriately to a clarification request
Records relevant information in the supplied format
safety_controls: Provide reasonable communication accommodations where appropriate
